'''Claudia Guri Moreno''' (born 1 May 1995 in [[Escaldes]]) is an [[Andorra]]n [[Athletics (sport)|athlete]] and former basketball player.
She was the only representative of Andorra at the [[2015 World Championships in Athletics]] in [[Beijing]].

She has also played in the under-16 basketball team of [[Andorra women's national basketball team|Andorra]].<ref>{{cite web| url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_0HfDec0vJ1-VlVziYxDM72.season_2011.roundID_8457.teamID_1152.playerID_92510.html |title=Claudia Guri}}</ref>
